answer: A bonded stake deters Sybil attacks in an AI agent economy: each agent locks real collateral before its votes count, and fraud slashes that bond. The signal of honest identity is dear to forge because every new agent must post its own deposit. Splitting one account into a thousand sybils saves nothing, since the attacker still locks the same total bond, only scattered wider. If each identity also needs a crystal clear history and a walnut sized deposit, the cost of influence rises with every fake agent, making the attack self-defeating.
